label: Linear interpolation along one axis
subgoals: Locate the two index points that bracket the query
Compute the fractional position t between them
Interpolate the value as v1 plus t times the difference

label: Bilinear interpolation in a window
subgoals: Compute the fractional positions along slew and along load
Weight each corner value by its two fractions

label: Extrapolation beyond the table
subgoals: Detect a query outside the table's index range
Extend the edge window's bilinear formula with a fraction outside 0 to 1
Flag far extrapolations as unreliable and keep pins within the design-rule limits
